# Global + LATAM AI & x402 API Suite (v2.7.1 — 12 Serverless Edge APIs)

> v2.7.1: every MCP server (`/mcp` on each host) now negotiates protocol 2024-11-05, 2025-03-26 or 2025-06-18 and lists intent-named tools with `title`, `annotations` (readOnly/destructive/idempotent/openWorld hints) and `outputSchema`; an unknown tool name returns JSON-RPC -32602 with the list of valid tools instead of reaching a paid route. Prices, routes and the x402 v2 contract are unchanged.

> EN: 12 ultra-fast Cloudflare Edge microservices (10-30 ms in Latin America) for autonomous AI agents, DeFi/crypto trading bots, fintechs, ERPs, n8n/LangChain workflows, and accounting automation. Pay per call in USDC on Base (`eip155:8453`) via x402 v2 — zero signup, zero API keys required (or optional B2B API Key).
> ES: 12 microservicios serverless en Cloudflare Edge para agentes de IA, bots DeFi/cripto y fintechs en México, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Perú, Uruguay y Brasil. Pago por llamada en USDC (Base) vía protocolo x402 v2, sin registro previo.
> PT: 12 microsserviços serverless na borda Cloudflare para agentes autônomos de IA (5 ferramentas globais de agentes & DeFi/cripto + 7 APIs fintech/fiscais LATAM e Brasil), monetizados nativamente via x402 v2 em USDC na Base ou chave B2B.

## Unified Gateway & MCP Server
- Unified API Hub: https://api.brunopompeo.com.br (`GET /llms.txt`, `GET /openapi.json`, `GET /catalog.json`, `GET /health`)
- Unified MCP Server (npm or GitHub, 1 command): `npx -y @brunopompeo/brazil-ai-x402-mcp` or `npx -y github:brunopompeo1/brazil-ai-fiscal-apis-x402` (14 paid tools across 12 APIs + 1 free status tool)
- Settlement Wallet (`payTo`): `0x20990fB239296a0A2d923C200Cb1C21187e2dA23` (USDC on Base `eip155:8453`)
- Live Free Trial (no signup/wallet): send header `X-Free-Trial: 1` (or MCP argument `"free_trial": true`) for 3 full results/day per IP on 11/12 APIs (disabled on `agent-email`)
- Prepaid API Keys (no crypto wallet needed — Stripe Card, Brazil Pix BRL, or Base USDC): https://credits.brunopompeo.com.br (`/card?pack=1|5|10`, `/pix?pack=1|5|10`, `/buy?pack=1|5|10`)
- Monthly B2B Plans in BRL (7-day free trial, Brazil Tax Reform CBS/IBS + full 12-API suite): https://credits.brunopompeo.com.br/empresas
- Marketplaces: RapidAPI (4 APIs: https://rapidapi.com/brunopompeo1/api/web-to-markdown-for-llm) & Apify Store (3 Actors: https://apify.com/brunopompeo)

## Global High-Volume Agent & DeFi Tools (5)
1. **Base & EVM DeFi Pre-Trade Shield (NEW v2.7)** — `POST/GET https://defi.brunopompeo.com.br/check` & `/wallet` ($0.015 USDC) | Multi-oracle token safety across 7 EVM chains (Honeypot.is V2 swap simulation + GoPlus + DexScreener live liquidity + DefiLlama oracle divergence `pass`/`warn`/`fail` + `safetyScore` 0–100 + `swapEligibility`) and EVM wallet phishing/sanctions audit + live Base ETH/USDC balances (`/wallet`) | `/sample` `/openapi.json` `/mcp`
2. **Crypto Perp Pulse & AI/Crypto Infra Outage Radar (NEW v2.7)** — `POST/GET https://pulse.brunopompeo.com.br/funding` & `/infra` ($0.015 USDC) | Live Hyperliquid perpetual funding rates (1h, 8h, APR %), mark/oracle basis, OI USD & long/short squeeze radar across ~180 markets (`/funding`) + live outage/incident status for 10 core AI & Crypto providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cloudflare, GitHub, Vercel, Supabase, Base, Coinbase, Solana, Alchemy) & Base RPC latency (`/infra`) | `/sample` `/openapi.json` `/mcp`
3. **Agent Guard — Prompt Injection & PII Firewall** — `POST https://guard.brunopompeo.com.br/guard` ($0.008 USDC) | Hybrid Llama Guard 3 8B + heuristics + PII/secret redaction | `/sample` `/openapi.json` `/mcp`
4. **Web Enrichment — Clean HTML → Markdown & JSON Tables** — `GET https://web.brunopompeo.com.br/clean?url=<URL>&format=json` ($0.002 USDC) | Up to 85% token reduction for RAG & LLM agents | `/sample` `/openapi.json` `/mcp`
5. **Agent Email — Transactional Email Dispatcher** — `POST https://email.brunopompeo.com.br/send` ($0.005 USDC) | Pay-per-send Markdown→HTML email with `dryRun` mode, zero SaaS subscription | `/sample` `/openapi.json` `/mcp`
